decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down, and radio and CMMS agree. The repair is likely done by 13:30 at the earliest. C590-09 has 256 t at 16.5 g/t, about 136 oz, and the repair would leave it unloaded for hours. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.4 oz/h, and arrives in 0.48 h. LH-10 comes out of preventive maintenance at 10:00 and arrives in 0.33 h. I left the critical-path loader LH-09 in place, since it is worth 5.7 oz/h. LH-08 alone would load about 195 t by 17:00 and LH-10 alone about 178 t. Together they clear the 256 t, about 136 oz, for roughly 3 oz of development cost. The Central stockpile is at 303 of 450 t and drains while LH-01 is down, so there is room for the extra ore.

Keep LH-08 at C590-09 (16.5 g/t, ~16 oz/h vs 0.4 dev cost). Send LH-10 (free after PM at 10:00, 0.49 h from the workshop) to E543-07 (300 t at 8.3 g/t, Este has truck headroom). That is about 6 h × 25.4 t/h ≈ 150 t ≈ 40 oz. Don't take LH-09 (critical dev, 5.7 oz/h vs ~6.8 oz/h gain, plus travel). Don't add loaders to Central, which is truck-limited. No reserves, since no stope was stopped.
